title: CrossVault
tagline: An arbitrage path finder inspired by the osmosis protorev module
description: The protoRev module takes advantage of possible arbitrages on the osmosis network at the end of each block, our little interface allows the near Blockchain NFT creators that believed in the varda vault by connecting their nfts and the collectors who bought the Varda NFTs to take advantage of that same RPC mechanics selecting custom tokens to check, if a possible arbitrage is found they will be prompt with a json file with the path, then they'll be able to upload the swapping path and invest their own near token into the arbitrage swap, using fusion+ to swap them crosschain.
how_its_made:
Osmosis and osmojs are a world worth mentioning, if I could learn more about celatone I would probably have added a flashloan function.
Fusion+ allows for the near Blockchain users to login with their near wallet, verify NFT ownership using https://api.varda.vision and access the arbitrage path creation interface, they can customize the tokens while accessing the osmosis RPC real time data and then download the json path file when they find the arbitrage.
They can then execute the arbitrage in the swapping UI, (one swap with fusion and one with osmosis.
